内容提要
上集“跨江击刘表”，叙述孙坚受袁术怂恿，进攻刘表，被刘表谋士蒯良设置伏兵射杀。
本集叙述董卓胁迫汉献帝建都长安后，倚吕布为心腹，凶横暴虐，大臣都敢怒而不敢言。司徒王允运用“连环计”，离间董卓、吕布关系，使吕布除掉董卓。
下集“犯长安”，叙述董卓死后，余党李傕、郭汜兴兵作乱，攻入长安，杀死王允，劫持献帝。

1. 董卓强迫献帝迁都长安以后，强征了二十五万民夫，在离长安二百多里的地方，另筑郿坞城，建造宫室，规模和京城不相上下。
page_text_en:
Content Summary
The previous volume, "Crossing the River to Attack Liu Biao," narrates how Sun Jian, incited by Yuan Shu, attacked Liu Biao and was killed by Liu Biao's strategist Kuai Liang, who had set an ambush.
This volume narrates how, after Dong Zhuo forced Emperor Xian to establish the capital in Chang'an, he relied on Lu Bu as his trusted confidant, became tyrannical and cruel, and caused ministers to be angry yet dare not speak out. The Minister of Works Wang Yun employed the "Chain Strategy" to sow discord between Dong Zhuo and Lu Bu, leading Lu Bu to eliminate Dong Zhuo.
The next volume, "Invading Chang'an," narrates how, after Dong Zhuo's death, his remnants Li Jue and Guo Si raised troops in rebellion, attacked Chang'an, killed Wang Yun, and seized Emperor Xian.

1. After Dong Zhuo forced Emperor Xian to relocate the capital to Chang'an, he forcibly conscripted 250,000 laborers and, at a location over two hundred miles from Chang'an, built the city of Mei Wu, constructing palaces on a scale comparable to the capital.
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《凤仪亭》的第2页，包含内容提要和第一幅插图。内容提要概述了上集、本集和下集的主要情节，第一幅图及文字描述了董卓强迫汉献帝迁都长安后，强征民夫在二百多里外建造郿坞城的场景。

page_text_en:
2. After the palace was completed, Dong Zhuo forcibly selected over eight hundred young women from the common people to serve as palace maids and concubines. The wealth plundered from the populace was countless; even the stored grain alone was sufficient for twenty years of consumption.
3. From then on, Dong Zhuo traveled back and forth between Chang'an and Meiwu, sometimes every half month, sometimes every month. His出入 was guarded by imperial troops, his presence grand and imposing. The officials, upon seeing this, felt injustice in their hearts, but dared not speak out.

5. 忽听董卓大喝一声：“将张温拖出去斩了！”吕布上前几步，把司空张温从筵席上揪了下来。
page_text_en:
4. One day, Dong Zhuo held a grand banquet for the hundred officials. After several rounds of wine, suddenly Lu Bu came in from outside, whispered something into Dong Zhuo's ear. Dong Zhuo nodded and smiled coldly. Everyone looked at each other in fear, worried about what terrible thing might happen next.
5. Suddenly, Dong Zhuo roared: "Drag Zhang Wen out and execute him!" Lu Bu stepped forward and pulled the Minister of Works, Zhang Wen, off his seat at the banquet.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了董卓在宴请百官时，吕布密报后，董卓下令处斩司空张温，吕布将其从席上揪下的场景，展现了董卓的专横与残暴。

Zhang Wen conspired with Yuan Shu and plotted to harm me. Unluckily, Yuan Shu's letter fell into the hands of my son, Feng Xian, so I had him executed. You gentlemen are not involved; there is no need to be alarmed.

8. 王允忧心如焚，不能入睡，深夜扶杖步入后园。他想起自己不能为朝廷出力，眼见许多大臣都遭到董卓毒手；顿时满腔悲愤，热泪横流。
9. 这时园中很静寂，忽然牡丹亭边，传来一阵伤感叹息之声，王允心里非常奇怪，便移步过去，掩在树后窥探。却是歌女貂蝉，独自在对月长叹。
page_text_en:
8. Wang Yun was deeply worried and couldn't sleep. In the dead of night, he leaned on his cane and walked into the back garden. He thought of his inability to help the court, and seeing many ministers fall victim to Dong Zhuo's cruelty; he was suddenly filled with sorrow and anger, tears streaming down his face.
9. At that moment, the garden was very quiet. Suddenly, from beside the Peony Pavilion, came a sound of sorrowful sighing. Wang Yun was very curious and moved closer, hiding behind a tree to peek. It was the singer Diaochan, sighing alone under the moonlight.
summary_zh: 王允因担忧董卓暴行而深夜在后园忧思，随后发现歌女貂蝉在牡丹亭边独自对月长叹。

11. 貂蝉说出了自己的心事。原来她见王允近来忧心国事，愁眉不展，想到自己一个弱女子，不能分愁解忧，因而在此长叹。王允不想貂蝉道着了自己的心事，更加感慨起来。
啊——想不到你有如此热心肠啊！
page_text_en:
10. Wang Yun thought to himself: "Diao Chan was selected into my household from a young age. I have always treated her like my own daughter. Why is she awake at this late hour, sighing repeatedly?" He then loudly asked, "Why are you sighing here at this late hour? Could there be some private matter?" Diao Chan was startled and hurriedly knelt down.
11. Diao Chan revealed her inner thoughts. She had seen Wang Yun recently worried about national affairs, his brow furrowed with concern, and she, as a weak woman, felt unable to ease his worries, so she sighed here. Wang Yun, not expecting Diao Chan to express his own inner feelings, became even more moved.
Ah— I never expected you to have such a kind heart!
summary_zh: 王允深夜在后园发现貂蝉独自叹息，询问后得知她因见自己忧国忧民而感伤，王允深受触动。

14. Wang Yun told Diaochan that Dong Zhuo had an adopted son, Lu Bu, who was exceptionally brave, and that the entire court was powerless against him. Therefore, he planned to use Diaochan to carry out the 'Chain Strategy' to cause a father-son conflict... Diaochan readily agreed. Wang Yun bowed in thanks and urged her not to reveal the secret.
15. Wang Yun immediately took several precious pearls from his home, hired skilled craftsmen to forge a golden crown, and sent it secretly to Lu Bu. The messenger reported back: 'Lu Bu was very pleased with the golden crown and said he would come in person to thank you tomorrow.' Wang Yun felt secretly delighted.
summary_zh: 王允向貂蝉说明用她实施‘连环计’以离间董卓与吕布的计划，貂蝉答应相助；随后王允派人将金冠送给吕布，吕布欣然接受并表示次日亲自道谢，王允对此感到欣慰。

page_text_en:
16. The next day, Lu Bu arrived as expected. Wang Yun had already prepared a feast, welcomed him into the back hall, and invited him to sit. Lu Bu said, 'I am merely a minor general in the Prime Minister's office; how could I be so bold in front of a high minister?' Wang Yun smiled and replied, 'In today's world, only you, General, deserve to be called a hero. Forget about rank; I am honoring your talent!
17. Wang Yun poured wine with great enthusiasm, speaking only of Dong Zhuo's merits or Lu Bu's martial prowess. Lu Bu felt immensely proud and simply enjoyed his drink heartily.
summary_zh: 王允设宴款待吕布，以敬酒和奉承之词拉近关系，吕布得意忘形，畅饮不休，为后续实施连环计做铺垫。

"Bring my child here!"

"How could there be such a beautiful woman in the world!" Wang Yun seized the opportunity and said, 
"Since General Lu Bu esteems me, our friendship is as close as family. Therefore, I have brought my daughter to meet you." 
She is my daughter, Diaochan.

他们手执宝剑，是何意思？
84. 到了宫门，董卓的军马都被挡在门外，只有御车的二十余人进去。董卓远远望见王允等都各执宝剑，立在殿门口。他心里起疑，回头问李肃，李肃却不答理。
85. 忽听得王允高声喊叫：“反贼已到，武士在哪里！”霎时两旁转出百余人，挺着刀枪向董卓直刺。
page_text_en:
They are holding swords. What does that mean?
84. Upon reaching the palace gate, Dong Zhuo's troops were all blocked outside, with only over twenty men from his carriage allowed in. Dong Zhuo saw Wang Yun and others standing at the palace entrance, each holding a sword. He became suspicious and turned to ask Li Su, but Li Su did not respond.
85. Suddenly, Wang Yun shouted loudly: "The traitor has arrived! Where are the warriors!" At once, over a hundred men emerged from both sides, brandishing swords and spears, charging straight at Dong Zhuo.
summary_zh: 董卓入宫时发现军马被拦，仅随从进入，见王允等人持剑立于殿前，心生疑虑，询问李肃未获回应。随后王允高呼‘反贼已到’，百余名武士从两侧冲出，持刀枪直刺董卓。

86. 但董卓身上裹着厚甲，没有被刺死，只刺伤了臂膀，从车上直滚下来。他嘴里大喊“吾儿奉先快来”！还想吕布来救他。
87. 吕布应声从车后转出，大叫“有诏讨贼”！一戟直刺董卓咽喉，顿时气绝了。
page_text_en:
86. But Dong Zhuo, wearing thick armor, was not killed; he was only wounded in the arm and rolled off the carriage. He shouted, 'My son, Fengxian, come quickly!' hoping that Lü Bu would save him.
87. Lü Bu emerged from behind the carriage, shouting, 'By imperial decree, we讨贼!' He thrust his halberd straight into Dong Zhuo's throat, and Dong Zhuo died instantly.
summary_zh: 董卓被刺伤后从车上滚落，呼喊吕布救援；吕布随即现身，一戟刺中董卓咽喉，将其杀死。

88. 吕布就怀中取出诏书，高声大叫：“奉诏讨贼臣董卓，其余一概不问。”将士们齐声欢呼。
89. 王允派人把董卓的女婿李儒杀了。又派吕布带领五万人马，到郿坞去抄没董卓的家私。
page_text_en:
88. Lu Bu took the imperial edict from his bosom and shouted loudly: 'By imperial decree, I come to punish the traitor Dong Zhuo; all others shall be spared.' The soldiers cheered in unison.
89. Wang Yun sent people to kill Dong Zhuo's son-in-law, Li Ru. He also sent Lu Bu with fifty thousand troops to Mei Wu to seize Dong Zhuo's property.
summary_zh: 吕布在宫中高举诏书宣布讨伐董卓，将士欢呼响应；随后王允派人杀死董卓女婿李儒，并派吕布率军前往郿坞抄没董卓家产。

90. 守郿坞的董卓心腹大将李傕、郭汜等，知董卓已死，吕布领兵将到，便连夜引兵，逃奔凉州去了。
91. 吕布进入郿坞，先取了貂蝉，然后擒杀了董卓的亲属，又把抄出来的金银财宝等，用数千辆大车运回长安。欲知李傕、郭汜等四将怎样作乱，请看下集《犯长安》
page_text_en:
90. The loyal generals of Dong Zhuo guarding Meiwu, Li Jue, Guo Si, and others, upon learning of Dong Zhuo's death and that Lü Bu's army was approaching, immediately led their troops at night and fled to Liangzhou.
91. Lü Bu entered Meiwu, first took Diaochan, then captured and killed Dong Zhuo's relatives, and transported the seized gold, silver, and treasures back to Chang'an using thousands of carts. To learn how Li Jue, Guo Si, and the other four generals caused chaos, please read the next chapter, 'Invading Chang'an'.
summary_zh: 董卓死后，其部将李傕、郭汜等人得知吕布率军将至，连夜逃往凉州。吕布则进入郿坞，夺取貂蝉，诛杀董卓亲属，并将抄没的财宝运回长安，故事引向下一章《犯长安》。
